summary: Similarweb Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) and attached proxy materials for a Special General Meeting of Shareholders to be held November 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Israel time at company headquarters in Givatayim. The sole proposal is approval of compensation terms for new Chief Executive Officer Michael Akkerman. Shareholders of record as of October 8, 2026 are entitled to vote, and the board recommends FOR the proposal. This is a routine meeting and compensation-approval matter rather than a special situation.
